tm.「おいおい まじかよ {var:1}！\n 城は オレたちを探す兵士で いっぱい: "Hey, hey, seriously, {var:1}! The castle is full of soldiers searching for us. Beyond here is way too dangerous!
tm.「牢屋に逆もどりなんて オレは ゴメンだ。\n 今は 逃げきることだけ考えようぜ: "I'm not going back to that cell. Let's just think about getting away for now!
tm.「見ないカオだから お兄さん 新入りだね？\n 最後の砦へ来たばかりなら 神の岩: "Don't recognize you. Are you new? If you just arrived at the Last Bastion, greet the king first, in front of the Goddess's rock.
tm.「おっと 待つんだ。\n 英雄殿が 帰還なされたからな。\n 北の入り口へ お迎: "Hold on. The hero has returned, so you should go welcome him at the north entrance.
tm.「……おっと 待ちなよ お兄さん。\n 神の岩に行って 何をしようっていうんだ。: "...Hold on, friend. What do you plan to do at the Goddess's rock? The King of Heliodor is calling for you.
tm.「……待て。我らの任務は\n 常闇を生む魔物を 倒すこと。\n 最後の砦を見捨て: "...Wait. Our mission is to defeat the monster that creates eternal dark. We can't abandon the Last Bastion and run.
tm.「この先に進む前に 砦へ戻り\n 常闇を生む魔物のこと……ホメロスのことを\n: "Before going further, let's return to the bastion and report the monster behind the eternal dark... Jasper... to the king at once.
tm.看板は 幼い文字で ラクガキされている。: The sign has been scribbled on in childish writing.
tm.王さまからの めいれいです。\nこの村の {var:1}は よい子なので\nみか: Order from the King: {var:1} of this village is a good child, so give them candy if you see them.
tm.不思議な ひかりのカベが ある。\n向こう側には 行けないようだ。: There's a strange wall of light. It seems you can't get through.
tm.「{var:1} 命の大樹に行く 準備はできた？: "{var:1}, are you ready to go to Yggdrasil?
tm.「村のみんなへの あいさつは済んだみたいね。\n じゃあ さっそく 勇者のつるぎ: "Looks like you've said goodbye to everyone in the village. Then let's go return the Luminary's sword to Yggdrasil.
tm.{var:1}は ベロニカとセーニャと共に\n命の大樹へ 向かった。: {var:1} headed to Yggdrasil with Veronica and Serena.
tm.「旅に出ると しばらくの間\n 村の人と話す 機会はなくなるわ。\n 今のうちに: "Once you set out, you won't have a chance to talk to the villagers for a while. Say your goodbyes now.
tm.「短い旅とはいえ 命の大樹に向かったら\n しばらく 村に帰ってこられませんわ。: "Though it's a short trip, once we head to Yggdrasil, we won't return to the village for a while.
tm.「戦いの準備などは 不要ですが\n イシの村の皆さまに あいさつを済ませ\n 旅: "No battle prep is needed, but say goodbye to everyone in Cobblestone and prepare your heart for the journey.
tm.「待つんだ {var:1}。お前を訪ねてきた\n お客さんが 北の入り口で 待っ: "Hold on, {var:1}. A visitor for you is waiting at the north entrance. Hurry and go see them.
tm.「ちょっと {var:1}！ 準備ができたら\n あたしに声をかけなさいって 言: "Hey, {var:1}! I told you to call me when you're ready. Don't leave the village on your own.
tm.この 木に巻きついた根からは もう\n不思議なチカラを 感じない。: The roots wrapped around this tree no longer give off any mysterious power.
tm.勇者の星の様子を 確かめるために\nデルカコスタ地方へ 向かおう。: To check on the star of the hero, let's head to the Heliodor Coast region.
tm.村長からの お知らせ\n{var:1}のおかげで 世界に平和が戻りました\nその: Notice from the Village Chief Thanks to {var:1}, peace has returned to the world. To celebrate, I will share one pun.
tm.皆の者！ ロトゼタシアに 平和が訪れたぞ！\nヘイ！ 輪になって祝うのだ！: Everyone! Peace has come to Erdrea! Hey! Gather in a circle and celebrate!
tm.こどもたちへ\nまものは いなくなりました\nこんど むらのそとへ ピクニックに: To the children: The monsters are gone. Let's go on a picnic outside the village soon.
